output_list.reason: The 'transfer' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The initial check 'if (balanceOf[msg.sender] < _value) throw;' is bypassed when the balance of the sender is at the boundary between zero and the transfer amount. An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to mint tokens for an arbitrary user.

The 'transferFrom' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The initial check 'if (balanceOf[_from] < _value) throw;' is bypassed when the balance of the sender is at the boundary between zero and the transfer amount. An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to mint tokens for an arbitrary user.

The 'mintToken' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function does not check if the total supply exceeds the maximum supply. An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to mint an arbitrary amount of tokens for an arbitrary user.

The 'buy' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function does not check if the balance of the contract is sufficient. An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to buy an arbitrary amount of tokens.

The 'sell' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The function does not check if the balance of the contract is sufficient. An attacker can exploit this vulnerability to sell an arbitrary amount of tokens.
